user.title: Connect to Tape Chart
user.description: In Tape Chart open **Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant**, pick the property and press **Generate pairing code**. Type the PMS address shown there and the code. The code is valid for 10 minutes.

data_description.pms_url: The address you open the PMS at: its domain, or its local network address with the port.
data_description.code: Eight letters and digits, like ABCD-EFGH

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {property} again
reauth_confirm.description: Tape Chart no longer accepts this Home Assistant for {property}. Generate a new pairing code for the same property in Tape Chart and type it here. The room mapping is kept.

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid web address.
error.insecure_url: Use a secure (HTTPS) address for a PMS on the internet. Plain HTTP is accepted only for an address in the local network.
error.invalid_code: The pairing code is not valid or was already used.
error.code_expired: The pairing code has expired. Generate a new one.
error.unreachable: Tape Chart could not reach this Home Assistant. Check the internal or external URL under Settings → System → Network, or enable Home Assistant Cloud.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the PMS. Check the address.
error.no_ha_url: Home Assistant has no URL configured. Set one under Settings → System → Network.

abort.repaired: This property was already paired. Its connection has been updated to the new pairing.
abort.other_property_updated: That code was for {property}; its connection has been updated. To fix this property, generate a code for this property and try again.
abort.wrong_property: That code is for another property. Generate the code for the same property.

map_entities.title: Room {room}
map_entities.description: Choose which entity plays which role. Only the entities chosen here are ever sent to Tape Chart. Leave a role empty if the room has nothing for it.

data_description.presence: Someone is physically in the room (motion, presence). binary_sensor or input_boolean.
data_description.keycard: A key card is in the holder.
data_description.dnd: The guest asked not to be disturbed.
data_description.mur: The guest asked for the room to be cleaned.
data_description.climate: Mode, set and current temperature come from it.
data_description.temperature: Only if the room temperature does not come from the thermostat.
data_description.alarm: Leak, smoke, SOS. Its device class is sent too.
data_description.scenario_welcome: The script or scene the PMS may run to prepare the room. Nothing else can be run from the PMS.
data_description.scenario_eco: The script or scene for the eco mode.
data_description.scenario_off: The script or scene that switches the room off.

fill_pattern.title: Fill by pattern
fill_pattern.description: Choose a room that is already mapped. For every other room the same entities are looked up: first inside that room's device (found by the room number in the device name, like "Room 206"), then by putting the room number into each entity id (room_205_pir → room_206_pir). Only entities that exist are proposed, and you will see them, and what was not found, before anything is saved.

data.overwrite: Replace roles that are already mapped

data_description.presence_hold_minutes: Presence 'on' is sent at once; 'off' only when it lasts this long.

error.nothing_found: No matching entities were found for the other rooms.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Check the connection to Tape Chart first.
abort.no_mapped_rooms: Map one room first, then fill the others from it.

auth_failed.message: Tape Chart refused this Home Assistant. Pair it again with a new code.

connection_lost.title: Tape Chart: {property} is disconnected
connection_lost.description: Tape Chart no longer accepts this Home Assistant for {property}, so room data and signals are not exchanged. Generate a new pairing code in Tape Chart (Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant) and open the Tape Chart integration here to pair again.
